jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager Germany (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Finance bekommt Ihre Handschrift.

Was würden Sie aufbauen, wenn Sie Finance für ein wachsendes Deutschlandgeschäft gestalten könnten?

Als businessnaher Senior Finance Manager entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion der deutschen Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers. Sie sind die zentrale Finance-Person vor Ort und gestalten mit dem Country Manager die nächsten Schritte des Geschäfts. Der Konzern verfügt über eigene Wirkstoff- und Arzneimittelherstellung.

About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

We’re building an energy company from first principles. That means rethinking the operational work behind it: which processes we need, how they run, and what agents can take on. You’ll build the AI systems that let Nomos serve more customers without scaling manual work at the same rate.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Clickpipes (CDC/Streaming)
jobs.description:
Note:. We are hiring for this role remotely in any country ClickHouse has a hiring presence.

About the Team

The ClickPipes - Database Integrations team builds the platform that enables real-time data replication from databases into ClickHouse at petabyte scale.

As a member of this team, you will be solving complex database-related challenges and distributed systems problems, such as understanding database internals to optimize snapshotting strategy, handling schema evolution during live replication, managing data type compatibility across systems, maintaining low end-to-end latency under unpredictable loads, and leveraging durable execution frameworks to ensure data consistency over unreliable networks. We work in the open — our database integrations are built on PeerDB, an open-source CDC platform we actively maintain and contribute to.

jobs.title: Founding Legal Engineer
jobs.description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
termios builds smart thermostats for real estate. Our product — termios Pro — replaces standard radiator thermostats in existing buildings, performs hydraulic balancing via a self-learning algorithm, and cuts heating energy consumption by up to 30%. No battery, no retrofitting: the device harvests energy from the temperature differential between radiator and room air (thermo-harvesting) and communicates over LoRaWAN.

The system runs at scale across multi-unit residential portfolios. Each thermostat is a constrained embedded device operating autonomously, syncing state through a LoRaWAN gateway to a cloud backend that runs the optimization logic. We're 35 people, growing, and the firmware team is small — your work ships directly to devices in real apartments.

Tasks

The firmware running on our smart thermostats — from first commit to field rollout. You write code, solder, measure, debug. No handoffs to someone else when it gets hard.

  • Thermostat firmware development and optimization
  • LoRaWAN communication stack (implementation + maintenance)
  • Low-power / energy harvesting optimization
